mainEntity.name: What types of materials are available for custom window frames?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom window frames are available in a variety of materials, each with distinct advantages. Common options include vinyl, known for its low maintenance and affordability; wood, valued for its classic aesthetics and natural insulation; fiberglass, offering strength, durability, and resistance to warping; and aluminum, chosen for its slim profiles and modern appeal. The choice of material often involves a practical tradeoff between cost, maintenance needs, energy efficiency, and desired aesthetic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom window frames come in vinyl (low maintenance), wood (classic, insulated), fiberglass (strong, durable), and aluminum (slim, modern), each with different pros and cons.
